findings.statement: Applied S2 is 30,764 compiled bytes (single-CBOR-wrapped flat; confirmed by the C2 header 590b5c = 3 + 2,908 = 2,911). A transaction carrying the script inline, or creating a reference-script output that contains it, is therefore >= 30,764 B. The ledger requires txsize <= maxTxSize (Conway UTXO -> Babbage.babbageUtxoValidation L420-421; formal Utxo.lagda.md L554). Observed Preprod maxTxSize is 16,384. S2 cannot be deployed inline or by reference under the observed parameters; the excess is >= 14,380 B (1.88x). C2 at 2,911 B fits. The A2r label 'reference-script bound' misnames 16,384: it is maxTxSize. Reference-script limits are the separate maxRefScriptSizePerTx (formal L555; implementation validateRefScriptSize) and a per-block limit; their values are not in the packet.
findings.grade: size: current-local actual; limit: provider-observed (anonymous Koios HTTP, single provider, no consensus/finality proof); rule: pinned source-only, not verified as the deployed node
findings.disposition: Hard Preprod blocker PB-01. Requires source work to reduce and split S2 (NEXT-CAPABILITY.md). No governance-change assumption.

findings.statement: Host CEK (aiken default cost model, trace silent; NOT ledger ExUnits). All 80 settle-path tests exceed the observed per-tx memory limit of 17.5 M (min h41 26,255,647). Decode harness estimated from the run's own tests: about 25.5 M mem / 6.74 B cpu per decode (sequential_chain_invoice_r1 / 2) and 28.27 M / 7.49 B (sequential_chain_reserve_r1). After subtracting it, single-thread settle production is about 48.7 M / 13.9 B (p01) to 65.2 M / 18.6 B (p04), i.e. 2.8-3.7x per-tx mem and 1.4-1.9x steps. A two-thread atomic settle (p07; one full pass 94,250,082) is estimated at about 120-135 M, above the per-block 77.5 M. The settle tx also includes the C2 release (about 18 M single pass including decode). Non-settle handlers: genesis 9.76 M, close 13.06 M, refund 3.63 M fit; revoke 17,500,956 and release 18,208,659 are at the margin before decode removal. The C2 Groth16 issue cost is unmeasured.
evidence: run/lib/pvc2/settle_r1_test.ak (accepted = facts + settle_checks; test_ctx via aiken/cbor.deserialise)
findings.grade: host-derived estimate; subtraction is approximate; cost model not pinned to Preprod
findings.disposition: Preprod blocker PB-02. Requires redesign for cost and an X1 compiled-wrapper evaluation under the pinned Preprod PlutusV3 cost model before any ledger-fit claim. Reviewer judgment: a cost-model difference alone is unlikely to close a gap above 2.5x.

findings.statement: The 37 'fail' tests pass if the predicate errors OR returns False. The 10 ERROR-PATH and 6 placeholder-signature tests are refusal evidence only; at trace level silent the failure location is unobserved. Cost profiles weakly corroborate the documented locations (e.g. p01 full refuses 74,127,913 vs facts 74,140,029; h33/h40/h41/h64 near decode-only cost) but do not show isolation.

No valid-signer positive (FX1). h63 relies on aiken's Rust Schnorr builtin returning False on a zero signature; the Haskell ledger builtin's behaviour on that input is unverified. Error or False both refuse, so only the isolation claim is affected.
C2 issue (Groth16 verification on BLS12-381 builtins) has no real VK/proof test; only groth16_refuses_short_vk (101 mem). Its ExUnits and its fit together with other redeemers are unmeasured.

Identical costs: h28/h30/h31 (76,608,381 / 21,122,584,936), h46_parts/h58_parts (9,756,452 / 2,641,286,080), cells_ordered_refuses_duplicate_cell/descending_accounts (28,131 / 8,373,210). This is consistent with equal-length mutations on the same path; the sources name distinct fixture constants. The fixture bytes were not read, so distinctness is unverified.
findings.disposition: Optional fixture-diff in a later authorized read; not a result defect.

In this packet, the per-tx ExUnits bound is evidenced only by the implementation (Alonzo.validateExUnitsTooBigUTxO, called at Babbage Utxo.hs L423-424). The formal Conway UTXO/UTXOW rules read here do not state it. No claim is made about the rest of the formal spec. Missing normative sources: Shelley validateMaxTxSizeUTxO/txsize definition; Babbage/Conway TxOut CDDL for script_ref framing; Conway PParams (maxRefScriptSizePerTx/perBlock values); Conway tiered reference-script fee (scriptsCost implementation); Babbage getMinCoinSizedTxOut; Alonzo script hashing; PlutusV3 cost-model parameter-name mapping; Conway stake-registration witness rules.

Formal UTXOW binds scriptIntegrityHash to the language views of the cost models in force (Utxow.lagda.md L261-266). ExUnits evidence must use the Preprod cost model actually in force; aiken-default CEK numbers cannot substitute.
